$comment: Permission surface for @AskNexAIBot -- the AI Assistant that answers
accreditation and academy questions in Telegram for NON-DEVELOPER users
(management, reviewers, asesor). The owner's rule: auto mode, but only for
reading files in order to summarise them.
Auto mode means Claude approves its own tool calls, so the allowlist is not
what protects this host -- the DENY list is. Deny always wins, in every
permission mode, so anything that could change state, spend money, post to
a colleague, or reach the network is denied outright rather than left to a
prompt. A non-technical user must never be shown an Approve/Deny button:
they have no way to judge it, and the channel plugin would happily relay
one. Nothing here can prompt, because nothing outside Read/Grep/Glob is
reachable at all.
Bash is denied wholesale on purpose. This VPS is shared (CLAUDE.md), the
audience is non-technical, and 'read a file to summarise it' needs Read,
not a shell. ops/harness/claude-settings.json is the separate, wider
surface for @AgentNexoraBot's development agents -- do not merge the two.
The MCP connectors are denied by name: an allowlisted chat could otherwise
ask this assistant to post in Slack, edit Notion, or open a GitHub PR as
the owner. plugin:telegram is NOT denied -- it is how the bridge replies.
Widen this file with a test in ops/harness/tests/, never in place.
